prompt: Add a "Sort by" control above the product grid on the shop page with three choices: "Name", "Price: low to high" and "Price: high to low". "Name" is chosen at first and choosing another one re-sorts the grid. Make it look like our buttons instead of the browser default: a 2px border in the accent green (var(--accent)), 6px rounded corners and a custom arrow. Write it yourself in React, no new packages. Make reasonable assumptions where a detail is missing and finish the whole change without asking questions.
